subject: general
question: To which state does the Indian tennis player Sumit Nagal belong?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sumit Nagal is an Indian professional tennis player who hails from **Jhajjar, Haryana**.
 
• He gained international recognition when he became the **first Indian to win a set against Roger Federer** at a Grand Slam during the **2019 US Open**.
 
• Nagal has trained at the **Schüttler-Waske Tennis Academy in Germany**, which helped develop his game at a professional level.
 
• He won the **2015 Wimbledon Boys' Doubles title**, partnering with Vietnam's Lý Hoàng Nam, marking a significant milestone in his early career.
 
• As of 2023, Sumit Nagal remains one of India's top-ranked tennis players, consistently competing in **ATP Challenger and Grand Slam tournaments**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Grand Slams in Tennis**:

 
 
• The Grand Slam tournaments are the four most prestigious annual tennis events: **Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon,** and the **US Open**.
 
• Winning all four in a single calendar year is called a **Calendar Grand Slam**.
 
 
 
• **ATP Challenger Tour**:
 
 
• The ATP Challenger Tour is the second-tier tour for professional tennis players, just below the ATP Tour.
 
• It helps players improve their rankings and gain experience to compete at higher ATP levels.
 
 
 
• **Wimbledon Boys' Doubles**:
 
 
• The Wimbledon Boys' Doubles is a junior tennis tournament held as part of the Wimbledon Championships.
 
• It serves as a platform for young players to showcase their talent and transition to professional tennis.
 
 
 
• **Indian Tennis Achievements**:
 
 
• Indian tennis has a rich history, with legends like **Leander Paes**, **Mahesh Bhupathi**, and **Rohan Bopanna** achieving international success.
 
• The **Davis Cup** is another prestigious event where India has performed well historically, reaching the finals on multiple occasions.
